equal.config/worker.ini:
; Settings of the inventory worker.
; Restart the worker after changing them.

[general]
name = inventory-worker
threads = 4
log_level = info

[queue]
host = localhost
port = 5672
retries = 5
; seconds between two retries
retry_delay = 10

[metrics]
enabled = true
port = 9200
path = /metrics
